svg.title: Workflow 6: Monday numbers
svg.text: Halyard’s own job-cost exporter: plain code, no AI, a file Wrenfield keeps.
Invoices, bills by job number, aged
Why code, not AI: totals must be right every time, and Xero’s terms keep its data out of AI training.
Bills match jobs because electricians now give the ServiceM8 job number at the trade counter.
Margin on every job, every week
A budget he can see, not guess
13-week cash forecast in the same sheet
Numbers don’t reconcile to Xero: no email,
